---
title: "2026 U.S. House Election Results"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

Nationwide interactive map of all **435 U.S. Congressional Districts** for the November 3, 2026 U.S. House elections. Hover over any district to see its name, winning side, and winner.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Read 2026 U.S. House results across all 435 districts
house_results <- read_csv("data/us_house_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Helper to place Alaska (02) and Hawaii (15) into a 270toWin-style bottom-left inset
place_insets <- \(sf_obj) {
  proj <- st_transform(sf_obj, 5070)
  ak <- filter(proj, STATEFP == "02")
  hi <- filter(proj, STATEFP == "15")
  conus <- filter(proj, !STATEFP %in% c("02", "15"))

  ak_cent <- st_centroid(st_union(st_geometry(ak)))
  st_geometry(ak) <- st_sfc(
    (st_geometry(ak) - ak_cent) * 0.35 + c(-1750000, 420000),
    crs = 5070
  )

  hi_cent <- st_centroid(st_union(st_geometry(hi)))
  st_geometry(hi) <- st_sfc(
    (st_geometry(hi) - hi_cent) * 1.1 + c(-1020000, 360000),
    crs = 5070
  )

  bind_rows(conus, ak, hi) |>
    st_transform(4326)
}

# Load 435 congressional district shapes and join 2026 election results
state_lookup <- fips_codes |>
  distinct(state_code, state_name)

us_districts <- congressional_districts(
  cb = TRUE,
  resolution = "20m",
  year = 2024,
  progress_bar = FALSE
) |>
  filter(as.numeric(STATEFP) <= 56, STATEFP != "11") |>
  place_insets() |>
  left_join(state_lookup, by = c("STATEFP" = "state_code")) |>
  mutate(
    cd_num = as.integer(CD119FP),
    location = if_else(
      cd_num == 0L,
      paste(state_name, "at-large"),
      paste(state_name, cd_num)
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(house_results, by = "location") |>
  mutate(
    winning_side = coalesce(winning_side, "Uncalled"),
    hover_label = sprintf(
      "<strong>%s</strong><br/>Side: <strong>%s</strong><br/>Winner: %s<br/><span style='color:#555;'>%s</span>",
      location,
      winning_side,
      coalesce(winner, "TBD"),
      coalesce(status, "")
    )
  )

# Load state outlines for crisp state boundaries (non-clickable overlay)
us_states <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2024, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  filter(as.numeric(STATEFP) <= 56, STATEFP != "11") |>
  place_insets()

# 270toWin-style party color palette
party_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#2166ac", "#b2182b", "#b0b0b0"),
  levels = c("Democratic", "Republican", "Uncalled")
)

us_bbox <- st_bbox(us_districts)

# Fixed-zoom nationwide interactive map (no external tile API required)
leaflet(
  us_districts,
  height = "560px",
  options = leafletOptions(
    zoomControl = FALSE,
    scrollWheelZoom = FALSE,
    doubleClickZoom = FALSE,
    touchZoom = FALSE,
    boxZoom = FALSE,
    keyboard = FALSE,
    dragging = FALSE,
    zoomSnap = 0.05
  )
) |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = us_bbox[["xmin"]],
    lat1 = us_bbox[["ymin"]],
    lng2 = us_bbox[["xmax"]],
    lat2 = us_bbox[["ymax"]]
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("function(el) { el.style.background = '#ffffff'; }") |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~party_pal(winning_side),
    fillOpacity = 0.88,
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 0.5,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#111111",
      fillOpacity = 1,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = map(us_districts$hover_label, HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("padding" = "6px 8px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addPolylines(
    data = us_states,
    color = "#333333",
    weight = 1.1,
    opacity = 0.85,
    options = pathOptions(clickable = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    colors = c("#2166ac", "#b2182b", "#b0b0b0"),
    labels = c("Democratic", "Republican", "Uncalled"),
    title = "2026 U.S. House",
    opacity = 0.9,
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

*Source: U.S. Census Bureau (`tigris` congressional district boundaries) and 2026 U.S. House election returns compiled via Wikipedia.*
